title: Canonical fixed-overlap transport of a given model map
statement: Let $I$ be a preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor, and $c$ a cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$, not necessarily a limit. Fix $i\leq j$, a scheme map $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$, and an open cover $U$ of $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Take arbitrary module sheaves $N_d$ on $U_d$, a module sheaf $M$ on $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}c.\mathrm{pt}$, and isomorphisms $e_d$ from the limit chart pullbacks of $N_d$ to the restrictions of $M$ [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. Fix $a,b$ and put $H=U_a\times_{X_j}U_b$ with projections $r_a,r_b$, and $g:H\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ equal to $r_a$ followed by $U_a\to X_j$ and its structure map [def-pc-fibre-product]. Put $H_0=H\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ using the map induced by $j\leq j$, and $F=(H_0\to H\to U_a)^*N_a$, $G=(H_0\to H\to U_b)^*N_b$. For $j\leq k$, write $q_0:H_k\to H_0$, $p_0:H_\infty\to H_k$, $t_0:H_\infty\to H_0$ for the canonical base changes, and $\sigma:P_{t_0}\cong P_{q_0}P_{p_0}$ for the canonical tensor-pullback comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Construct $\theta:P_{t_0}F\to P_{t_0}G$ by conjugating the transition of $M$ on $H_\infty$ by the restrictions of $e_a,e_b$, using the canonical composition comparisons and the adjunction identification of tensor and abstract pullback [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Given a map $\alpha:P_{q_0}F\to P_{q_0}G$ with $\sigma_F\circ P_{p_0}(\alpha)=\theta\circ\sigma_G$ (Lean composition order), set $V=U\times_{X_j}X_k$, $A_d=(V_d\to U_d)^*N_d$, and $K_k=V_a\times_{X_k}V_b$. There is a canonical map $d_k:K_k\to H_k$, prescribed by the two projections to $U_a,U_b$ and by the structure map to $\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$. The canonical composition isomorphisms $t_a,t_b$ identify $d_k^*P_{q_0}F,d_k^*P_{q_0}G$ with the two restrictions of $A_a,A_b$. Define $\varphi=t_a^{-1}\circ d_k^*(\alpha)\circ t_b$ (Lean order). Then $\varphi$ satisfies the canonical pair square with the descent transition of $M$ and the iterated chart comparisons [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons]. This is a fixed-stage calculation: it has no directedness, finite presentation, quasi-coherence, affineness, quasi-compactness, Noetherian or limit hypothesis, and asserts no existence of a later stage.

proof.text: Construct the canonical map z from the iterated universal overlap to the fixed limit model by pullback.lift. Prove its two chart equations and its commutative square z followed by p_0 equals l followed by d_k by comparing the overlap projection and the base projection. These proofs use the explicit definitions, the cone equations, and pullback uniqueness.

Identify the supplied stage and limit comparison isomorphisms with the generic explicit constructors by definitional equality. Unfold overlapPairMapOfModel once to obtain its defining equation. Apply the arbitrary-theta stage restriction theorem to alpha, the given overlapModelConjugate, and the supplied tensor compatibility (recovery) equation. It concludes that the canonical base change of the transported pair map equals the direct restriction of that conjugated model map. The tensor inverse cancellation is part of this strictly smaller stage restriction statement; it has no limit module or descent transition. The first and second stage comparisons are named irreducible constructions with defining equations, so comparison specialization does not unfold their large terms.

Identify overlapModelConjugate with the generic explicit conjugated transition by definitional equality. Apply the conjugated-transition restriction theorem to the already constructed geometric model map and to overlapPairMapOfModel. The stage identity, after substitution of the cancelled recovery equation, supplies its base-change premise. Its conclusion is exactly overlapPairSquare; no stage morphism or recovery argument is hidden in this restriction theorem. A proved private generic helper combines the two restriction theorems before specializing them to the concrete overlap; this avoids expensive unfolding and adds no proof obligation.

theorem overlap_pair_square_of_model_recovery
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec))
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (e : ∀ a, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom
      (baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))) a)).obj (N a) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ (baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))).f a)).obj M)
    (a b : U.I₀)
    (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    let g := overlapModelHom R f hij U a b
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapModelChart R f hij U a b a
      (pullback.fst (U.f a) (U.f b)))).obj (N a)
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapModelChart R f hij U a b b
      (pullback.snd (U.f a) (U.f b)))).obj (N b)
    let q₀ := overlapStageMap R g (le_refl j) hjk
    let p₀ := overlapLimitMap R c g ((le_refl j).trans hjk)
    let t₀ := overlapLimitMap R c g (le_refl j)
    let σ := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso p₀ q₀ t₀ (by
      dsimp only [p₀, q₀, t₀, overlapLimitMap, overlapStageMap]
      rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
      congr 1
      ext
      simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op)
    ∀ α : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj G,
      σ.hom.app F ≫ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p₀).map α =
        overlapModelConjugate R c f hij U a b N M e ≫ σ.hom.app G →
      let q := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V := U.pullback₁ q
      let p := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      let A := fun d ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q d)).obj (N d)
      let W := V.pullback₁ p
      let D := (modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData W.f).obj M
      let ε := overlapIteratedComparison U q p (overlapLimitMap R c f hij)
        (by
          dsimp only [p, q, overlapLimitMap, overlapStageMap]
          rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
          congr 1
          ext
          simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op) N M e
      overlapPairSquare V A p D ε a b
        (overlapPairMapOfModel R f hij U a b hjk N α)
